minutes.headline: Planning Board endorsed a 3-lot ANR on Prospect Street, approved a solar special permit, and continued a stormwater hearing.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed the approval-not-required plan for 274 Prospect Street, approved a de minimis name change for the cannabis shop at 43 Summer Street, and continued the 274 Prospect stormwater hearing to October 23 while awaiting the town engineer's review and Conservation. It closed the hearing and approved a large-scale ground-mount solar special permit at 560 Malpas Road with standard conditions and construction hours. The meeting ended with committee reports, solar warrant article discussion, and thanks to the departing town planner, whose last meeting this was.

public_comment.topic: Concerns about sight lines and snow removal for driveways on Pond Street across from 274 Prospect; pleased the project is smaller; interest in sewer extension to Pond Street.
Explained reasons for ground-mount solar: roof too old to carry panels, high electric bills, new electric vehicle.
Thanked the departing planner for his service to the town.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved a special permit for a large-scale ground-mount solar array at 560 Malpas Road, with standard conditions and set construction hours.
The board closed the public hearing for 560 Malpas Road before voting on the permit; vote counts were not audible.
The board continued the 274 Prospect Street stormwater hearing to October 23, pending the town engineer's review and a Conservation Commission hearing.
The board voted to endorse an approval-not-required plan for three lots at 274 Prospect Street; the result was not audible in the recording.
The board had no objection to combining the three solar warrant articles into one, and it noted it was the departing town planner's last meeting.

why_it_matters: The Malpas Road permit allows a ground-mount solar array with set construction hours, and the combined solar warrant article is one a resident may be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.

The Prospect Street project, three lots with a stormwater permit still pending, shows where drainage and neighboring road concerns about sight lines and snow removal would be reviewed before building proceeds.

The Select Board meeting where the planner is to present the combined solar warrant article.
